applies_to: every Phase 14 final-policy candidate checkpoint (hour 0, 6, 12, ..., 162, 168), each evaluated on the identical frozen phase14_checkpoint_selection_pack_v1

pack_binding.ewr: wins + 0.5*draws over the stratum's 32 games, divided by 32

primary: select the candidate with the highest equal-weight mean EWR across the four strata: mean = (EWR_phase9 + EWR_strategic + EWR_tactical + EWR_scoutrush) / 4
tie_break_1: among candidates exactly tied on the primary, select the one with the highest minimum opponent-stratum EWR
tie_break_2: if still exactly tied, select the later checkpoint (larger candidate hour)
statistics: no confidence intervals, no statistical tests, no post-run reweighting; exact arithmetic on the frozen pack results only
procedure_at_hour_168: training stops at the frozen deadline semantics
complete any missing fixed-pack candidate evaluations (selection time is outside training time; no additional optimizer updates may occur)
prohibitions: the rule may not be changed after Phase 14 begins
candidate evaluation may never alter ongoing training: it cannot stop training early, change LR, opponent mixture, setup source, historical-pool logic, checkpoint cadence, or the deadline
if an evaluation fails during the run, preserve the candidate, continue training, evaluate later with the same frozen pack
the hour-168 checkpoint is a candidate, not automatically the deployed final policy
